# github-markdown-css

Vendored from github-markdown-css **5.8.1**, MIT license (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/sindresorhus/github-markdown-css
Asset: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/github-markdown-css@5.8.1/github-markdown.css

Local modification: the two OS color-scheme media queries use `@media all`
and their inner selectors use `[data-theme="dark"] .markdown-body` /
`[data-theme="light"] .markdown-body`, so the site toggle controls the palette.
Project colors and responsive adjustments live in ../../markdown.css.
